 ‘Snakes from behind!’ Watch PFL’s biggest star ambush, bloody former UFC champ ahead of RAF Abu Dhabi
 by Jesse Holland Nov 11, 2026, 5:13 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Jesse Holland is among the longest-tenured media professionals in the combat sports news space, covering MMA, professional wrestling and boxing on a full-time basis since early 2004. Payback? 
 Former UFC bantamweight champion, Merab Dvalishvili, was just ambushed by PFL lightweight kingpin Usman Nurmagomedov ahead of the RAF Abu Dhabi fight card this weekend in UAE.
 “I was doing an interview for RAF in the hotel lobby and Usman and his buddies came up from behind and started punching me and my young friend,” Dvalishvili wrote on Instagram . “Security was holding me. They kept kicking us when we were down like losers.”
 Here’s another look:
 This may (or may not) affect Usman’s chances of signing with UFC .
 Dvalishvili’s feud with the Nurmagomedov family dates back to “The Machine’s” rivalry with Umar Nurmagomedov at UFC 311 back in early 2025 . That said, Dvalishvili was the first to get physical, slapping a member of the Umar goon squad at the RAF event last July in Georgia.
 I guess he forgot what happens when you disrespect someone from the Nurmagomedov clan .
 Related
 Merab Dvalishvili gets into scuffle with Umar Nurmagomedov fans at RAF Georgia 
 “Usman Nurmagomedov and his friends came like snakes from behind!” Dvalishvili added. “What kind of fighters are you guys?! What kind of man does this?! If you want to fight, let’s do like real way, bro! You guys came just because there’s two of us, and you guys were prepared, bro! What the f*ck?! That shows your character, shows you’re not real men! If you want to fight, let’s f*cking fight!”
 Maybe they took lessons from this sucker-punching thug .
 Related
 Umar Nurmagomedov Wants A Piece Of Merab Dvalishvili 
 Merab is scheduled to wrestle fellow UFC vet Marlon Moraes in this weekend’s RAF Abu Dhabi lineup .
